mapper.select: select i.INSURANCE_ID, i.INSURANCE_TYPE, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'NEW_INSURANCE_TYPE' and code_value = i.INSURANCE_TYPE) as insurance_type_n, i.INSURANCE_DATE_FROM, i.INSURANCE_DATE_TO, i.INSURANCE_COMPANY, i.INSURANCE_NUMBER, i.INSURANCE_AMOUNT, i.FIRST_BENEFICIARY, i.CREATION_DATE, i.CON_LEASE_ITEM_ID from CON_LEASE_ITEM_INSURANCE i where i.CON_LEASE_ITEM_ID = #{conLeaseItemId} order by i.INSURANCE_DATE_FROM desc

select * from ( select T1.INSURANCE_ID, t3.CONTRACT_NUMBER, t3.CONTRACT_NAME, t2.FULL_NAME, t1.INSURANCE_TYPE, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'NEW_INSURANCE_TYPE' and code_value = t1.INSURANCE_TYPE) as insurance_type_n, t1.INSURANCE_DATE_FROM, t1.INSURANCE_DATE_TO, t1.INSURANCE_COMPANY, t1.INSURANCE_NUMBER, t1.INSURANCE_AMOUNT, t1.FIRST_BENEFICIARY from con_lease_item_insurance t1 inner join con_contract_lease_item t2 on t1.con_lease_item_id = t2.contract_lease_item_id inner join con_contract t3 on t2.contract_id = t3.contract_id) v
and v.contract_number like concat('%', concat(#{contractNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.contract_name like concat('%', concat(#{contractName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.full_name like concat('%', concat(#{fullName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_type like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and to_date(v.insurance_date_from,'yyyy-mm-dd') >= to_date(#{insuranceDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and to_date(v.insurance_date_to,'yyyy-mm-dd') <= to_date(#{insuranceDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and v.insurance_company like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceCompany,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_number like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.INSURANCE_AMOUNT = #{insuranceAmount}
and v.first_beneficiary like concat('%', concat(#{firstBeneficiary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
order by t1.INSURANCE_DATE_FROM desc

select * from (select t1.insurance_id, t3.contract_id, t3.contract_number, t3.contract_name, t3.contract_status, t2.full_name, t1.insurance_type, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'NEW_INSURANCE_TYPE' and code_value = t1.insurance_type) as insurance_type_n, t1.insurance_date_from, t1.insurance_date_to, t1.insurance_company, t1.insurance_number, t1.insurance_amount, t1.first_beneficiary from con_contract_lease_item t2 inner join con_contract t3 on t2.contract_id = t3.contract_id left join con_lease_item_insurance t1 on t1.con_lease_item_id = t2.contract_lease_item_id where t3.document_type in ('CONL', 'CONLB') and t2.full_name is not null) v
and v.contract_number like concat('%', concat(#{contractNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.contract_name like concat('%', concat(#{contractName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.full_name like concat('%', concat(#{fullName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_type like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_date_from >= to_date(#{insuranceDateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and v.insurance_date_to <= to_date(#{insuranceDateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')
and v.insurance_company like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceCompany,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.insurance_number like concat('%', concat(#{insuranceNumber,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and v.INSURANCE_AMOUNT = #{insuranceAmount}
and v.first_beneficiary like concat('%', concat(#{firstBeneficiary,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
order by v.contract_id desc

select ii.*,(select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'NEW_INSURANCE_TYPE' and code_value = ii.INSURANCE_TYPE) as insurance_type_n from CON_CONTRACT_LEASE_ITEM i, CON_LEASE_ITEM_INSURANCE ii where i.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} and i.CONTRACT_LEASE_ITEM_ID = ii.CON_LEASE_ITEM_ID
select count(i.INSURANCE_ID) from CON_LEASE_ITEM_INSURANCE i where i.INSURANCE_NUMBER = #{insuranceNumber}
